name: Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Long-only weekly-rebalanced portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Weights are inverse of 21-day annualized realized volatility, normalized to sum to 100% with a 40% per-asset cap. Rebalances every Monday (first trading day of the week). No stop-loss or take-profit — rebalancing is the sole exit mechanism. Auto-generated tearsheet for performance measurement.
source:
# =============================================================================
# Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio: SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC
# =============================================================================
# Weights = 1/vol(21d), normalized, capped at 40% per asset.
# Rebalance weekly on Monday open. Long-only, no stops.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()

# --- Volatility (21-day annualized) ---
# volatility() takes close prices and computes annualized vol internally (skill S47)
vol_21 = volatility(src.c, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)

# --- Inverse-Volatility Weights ---
# inv_vol_weight: cross-sectional inverse-vol weighting with 40% cap
# All assets always active (long-only buy-and-hold with rebalancing)
always_active = src.c > 0
weights = inv_vol_weight(max_weight=0.4, min_volatility=0.01)(active_mask=always_active, volatility=vol_21)

# --- Rebalance Trigger: Weekly on Monday ---
ts = index().value
is_rebal = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week, boundary=BoundaryType.start, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.monday)(ts)

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: all assets always held long, rebalanced weekly
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=always_active)

# Position sizing: vol-scaled weights, rebalance only on Mondays
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights.weight * 100, rebalance_on=is_rebal)
